systems.name: Session lifecycle
systems.note: Hello/scene/snapshot handshakes and catch-up retries implemented. Cleanup is scoped to the original stream; repeated TCP replacement sessions are regression tested. Full gameplay reconnect recovery remains pending.

systems.name: NPC brains
systems.note: Cabin and chapter registries suppress client brains and mirror host state. Native random pedestrian pools now mirror host prefab/slot/count inventories before AI snapshots, including Office during the additive typing game.

systems.name: Doors / Holdables
systems.note: CabinDoor + NOTLonely_Door.DoorScript + Holdable replicated across all synced scenes.

systems.name: Story flags
systems.note: Per-scene flag dictionaries plus 30 explicit Cabin arrival, toilet, intro and late-story fields with native-value digests. Full story branches and save/resume parity remain unverified.

systems.name: Dialogue mirroring
systems.note: Host dialogue events mirrored; native subtitle UI used when available; client UI suppressed.

systems.name: Camera / FOV
systems.note: Deep Cabin/Pizzeria/RoadTrip; Office/Parking land FOV + dialogue camera at least.

systems.name: Vehicles
systems.note: RoadTrip and Pizzeria passenger seats are in active testing with F12 seatbelt toggles, synthetic rear/truck-bed anchors, and typed vehicle smoothing. Cabin intro seating still needs polish.

systems.name: Traffic
systems.note: Cabin + Pizzeria + RoadTrip traffic pool/active state + AiTransform correction.

systems.name: UI mirror
systems.note: Existing chapter UI/phone mirroring plus 0.4.47 host-driven typing-game and credits transforms, activation, text, color, camera, animation, word/progress, health and audio state.

systems.name: Avatars
systems.note: Auto now uses an original skinned winter traveler with saved face, skin, hair, clothing colors and accessories. Reliable session/revision-checked appearance messages survive scene transitions. Directional body/limb animation, head/torso aim and hand targets run in both directions. Explicit legacy visual overrides remain available. Full visual/story calibration remains pending.

systems.name: Diagnostics
systems.note: Ten-scene route checks snapshots, both skeletons, native Host/Join, typing words, story-field digests, lookup reuse and distinct live appearance changes. Character menu probes verify Apply/Discard and cancellation. Local log collector includes capture times and installed DLL/helper hashes; native crashes remain failures.

systems.name: Co-op setup UI
systems.note: Native Multiplayer entry above Episodes opens modern Co-op and Character pages. Co-op offers LAN/Spacewar, Host/Join, lobby copying, name/address/port fields, Disconnect and Start story. Character offers a rotating 3D preview, face/body framing and saved clothing/face choices. F11 opens this menu in MainMenu and the advanced panel in gameplay.

systems.name: Cabin Mike sync
systems.note: MikeCabin, MikeFishing, MikePostEating, MikeAfterHiding, MikeCabinCookController all wired through NpcBrainState.

systems.name: Mini-game state
systems.note: Jenga + Ouija controller + planchette + dining-table colliders + initial-position state synced.

systems.name: Cooking props
systems.note: Casserole/oven/plate/fish/cooking-hand props gated by story flags; client visuals suppressed before Eating.

systems.name: Vending machines
systems.note: Shared between Office + Pizzeria. Cameras, triggers, slot/sliding colliders, soda-can state, audio.

systems.name: Generic triggers
systems.note: OnTriggerSub + OnTriggerDisplaySub + OnTrigger + TriggerEventInvoker mirrored across all 4 non-Cabin scenes.

systems.name: Save / load parity
systems.note: Game's ES3 save state not synced across host/client. Sessions assume both start from the same point.

systems.name: Mid-session reconnect
systems.note: TCP automatically retries and the scene handshake can resend snapshots. Complete mid-story recovery and persistent save restoration are not yet validated.

systems.name: Menu / loading scenes
systems.note: Scene handshakes cover menu return and preserve Office across additive typing-game transitions. Client-only minigame controls are suppressed; host owns its gameplay. Lobby/menu choices remain local.

systems.name: IL2CPP migration
systems.note: Game ships as Mono. Plugin has a TODO marker for an eventual IL2CPP chainloader swap.

systems.name: Spacewar transport
systems.note: Isolated App ID 480 helper and two-player lobbies. Connection readiness requires received peer packets; helper errors persist in Multiplayer. Native initialization/lobby/relay and helper fixtures pass. The tester-reported two-PC kick still requires a real retest.

systems.name: Credits / typing-game presentation
systems.note: Host-authored presentation and additive lifecycle implemented. Typing remains controlled by the host; full minigame completion, death effects and visual/audio calibration still need gameplay validation.

systems.name: Scene lookup work
systems.note: Scene-state adapters reuse Unity searches within one update, invalidate on object inventory changes and clear at scope exit. Runtime counters measure avoided searches; no FPS improvement percentage is claimed.
